title: Nutritious Earthy Peruvian Duck Arroz Con Pato
description: This Peruvian arroz con pato dish is made with duck, chicken bouillon powder, and earthy spices, and is a hearty and flavorful meal. It is also ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and can be served at dinner time.
instructions: Heat the duck fat in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken bouillon powder and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked white rice and stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the duck legs to the saucepan.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 25 minutes.
Remove the duck legs from the saucepan and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve with the duck legs.
